name: MIS Activity Attendance Analysis Wing and Houseblocks
description:
Is used to track performance of Wing/Houseblock Activity Attendances by pinpointing where a prisoner was located at the time of the activity. This differs from the Activity Attedance Analysis report as it only retrieves prisoners who were actively on a prison roll at the time of the Activity Session Dates selected at runtime. This will provide a more accurate picture as it excludes prisoners who have left the establishment but are still allocated to an activity.
ACT0037 v00.00.01 Last Modified: 27/06/2019

dataset.name: Activities
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT AT_ACTIVITY_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_CODE_NK, AT_ACTIVITY_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_DESCRIPTION, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE.DESCRIPTION, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_TYPE.DESCRIPTION AS ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, TRUNC(AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.START_TIME) AS ACTIVITY_SESSION_DATE, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.STATUS, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.START_TIME, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.END_TIME, ((AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.END_TIME - AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.START_TIME) * 24 * 60 * 60) / 60 / 60 AS ACTIVITY_SESSION_DURATION, COALESCE(AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.SLOT_CATEGORY_CODE, 'No Slot') AS SLOT_AS_DIMENSION, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.ALLOCATED_FLAG, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.SURNAME, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.COMMENT_TEXT, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE.CODE, AT_DIM_SERVICE_CATEGORY.CODE AS ACTIVITY_SERVICE_CATEGORY_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT (AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY)) AS COUNT_OF_OFFENDERS, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_TYPE.CODE AS ACTIVITY_CODE, AT_DIM_ACTIVITY_STATUS.DESCRIPTION AS ACTIVITY_SESSION_STATUS_DESC35, AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.ASSIGNMENT_TIME, AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.ASSIGNMENT_END_TIME, AT_TO_CELL.UNIT_4_DESCRIPTION, AT_FROM_CELL.UNIT_4_DESCRIPTION AS MOVEMENT_LOCATION_FROM_DESCR35, AT_TO_CELL.UNIT_1_CODE, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 'DD-MON-YYYY') AS CURRENT_DATE FROM BODIMIS.FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY, BODIMIS.DIM_ESTABLISHMENT AT_ACTIVITY_ESTABLISHMENT, BODIMIS.DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE, BODIMIS.DIM_PROGRAMME_TYPE AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_TYPE, BODIMIS.DIM_OFFENDER_BOOKING AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING, BODIMIS.DIM_REFERENCE_CODES AT_DIM_SERVICE_CATEGORY, BODIMIS.DIM_REFERENCE_CODES AT_DIM_ACTIVITY_STATUS, BODIMIS.FACT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY, BODIMIS.DIM_CELL AT_TO_CELL, BODIMIS.DIM_CELL AT_FROM_CELL, (SELECT * FROM dual) DT_DUAL, (SELECT LAG(fbah.living_unit_sk) OVER (PARTITION BY offender_booking_sk ORDER BY Assignment_time) AS from_cell, bed_assign_seq_nk, offender_booking_sk FROM bodimis.fact_bed_assignment_history fbah) DT_FROM_CELL WHERE (AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK (+) = AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK) AND (AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.LIVING_UNIT_SK = AT_TO_CELL.UNIT_4_SK (+)) AND (AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK IN (SELECT CSL.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK FROM BODIMIS.DIM_STAFF_ACCESSIBLE_CASELOAD SAC, BODIMIS.DIM_CASELOAD_SECURITY_LIST CSL WHERE SAC.CASELOAD_ID = CSL.CASELOAD_CODE AND SAC.USERNAME = UPPER((SELECT username FROM context_ /* = #Variable('BOUSER') */)) AND CSL.ENDYEAR >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY') - 6)) AND (AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK) AND (AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_TYPE.PROGRAMME_TYPE_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.PROGRAMME_TYPE_SK) AND (AT_DIM_ACTIVITY_STATUS.CODE_DOMAIN (+) = 'PS_PA_OC') AND (AT_DIM_ACTIVITY_STATUS.CODE (+) = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.STATUS) AND (AT_ACTIVITY_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.ESTABLISHMENT_SK) AND (AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE.PROGRAMME_SERVICE_SK = AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.PROGRAMME_SERVICE_SK) AND (AT_DIM_SERVICE_CATEGORY.CODE_DOMAIN (+) = 'PS_CATEGORY') AND (AT_DIM_SERVICE_CATEGORY.CODE = AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE.PROGRAM_CATEGORY) AND (AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.BED_ASSIGN_SEQ_NK = DT_FROM_CELL.BED_ASSIGN_SEQ_NK AND AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK = DT_FROM_CELL.OFFENDER_BOOKING_SK) AND (DT_FROM_CELL.FROM_CELL = AT_FROM_CELL.UNIT_4_SK (+)) AND (AT_ACTIVITY_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_CODE_NK = (SELECT ESTABLISHMENT_CODE FROM prompt_ /* = #prompt('Enter Establishment Code','A','Activities\Activity Establishment Code',Mono,Free,Not_Persistent,,User:0) */) AND TRUNC(AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.START_TIME) BETWEEN (SELECT START_DATE FROM prompt_ /* = #prompt('Enter Start Date','D',,Mono,Free,Not_Persistent,,User:1) */) AND (SELECT END_DATE FROM prompt_ /* = #prompt('Enter End Date','D',,Mono,Free,Not_Persistent,,User:2) */) AND AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.ALLOCATED_FLAG = 'Y') GROUP BY AT_ACTIVITY_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_CODE_NK, AT_ACTIVITY_ESTABLISHMENT.ESTABLISHMENT_DESCRIPTION, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE.DESCRIPTION, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_TYPE.DESCRIPTION, TRUNC(AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.START_TIME), AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.STATUS, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.START_TIME, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.END_TIME, ((AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.END_TIME - AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.START_TIME) * 24 * 60 * 60) / 60 / 60, COALESCE(AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.SLOT_CATEGORY_CODE, 'No Slot'), AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.ALLOCATED_FLAG, AT_OFFENDER_BOOKING.SURNAME, AT_FACT_OFFENDER_ACTIVITY.COMMENT_TEXT, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_SERVICE.CODE, AT_DIM_SERVICE_CATEGORY.CODE, AT_DIM_PROGRAMME_TYPE.CODE, AT_DIM_ACTIVITY_STATUS.DESCRIPTION, AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.ASSIGNMENT_TIME, AT_BED_ASSIGNMENT_HISTORY.ASSIGNMENT_END_TIME, AT_TO_CELL.UNIT_4_DESCRIPTION, AT_FROM_CELL.UNIT_4_DESCRIPTION, AT_TO_CELL.UNIT_1_CODE, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 'DD-MON-YYYY')), dataset_ AS (SELECT ESTABLISHMENT_CODE_NK, ESTABLISHMENT_DESCRIPTION, DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, ACTIVITY_SESSION_DATE, STATUS, START_TIME, END_TIME, ACTIVITY_SESSION_DURATION, SLOT_AS_DIMENSION, OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, ALLOCATED_FLAG, SURNAME, COMMENT_TEXT, CODE, ACTIVITY_SERVICE_CATEGORY_CODE, COUNT_OF_OFFENDERS, ACTIVITY_CODE, ACTIVITY_SESSION_STATUS_DESC35, ASSIGNMENT_TIME, ASSIGNMENT_END_TIME, UNIT_4_DESCRIPTION, MOVEMENT_LOCATION_FROM_DESCR35, UNIT_1_CODE, CURRENT_DATE, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) AS V_SCHEDULED_PRISONERS, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'ATT') AS V_ACTUAL_ATTENDED, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'ACCAB') AS V_ACCEPTABLE_ABSENCE, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'CANC') AS V_CANCELLED, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'NREQ') AS V_NOT_REQUIRED, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'UNACAB') AS V_UNACCEPT_ABSENCE, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'UNBEH') AS V_UNACCEPT_BEHAVIOUR, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'REST') AS V_REST_DAY, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS = 'COURT') AS V_COURT, COUNT(OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY) OVER (PARTITION BY STATUS IS NULL) AS V_NOT_RECORDED FROM dataset_base_)

field.name: ASSIGNMENT_END_TIME

dataset.name: MIS Load
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.BUSINESS_DATE FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE (BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG.LOAD_ID = (SELECT MAX(LOAD_ID) FROM BODIMIS.ETL_LOAD_LOG WHERE NOT LOAD_END_DATETIME IS NULL))), dataset_ AS (SELECT BUSINESS_DATE FROM dataset_base_)

filter.name: prefilter_
filter.query: prefilter_ AS (SELECT * FROM dataset_ WHERE V_ACTIVITY_SESSION_DATE_RELE32 IN ('Y'))
